primaries.name: SMG
primaries.desc: A rapid-fire submachine gun for close fights
use: LMB
Hold to fire 14 rounds a second; short bursts keep the spread tight
Hits fade past 30 m, to 40% by 70 m

primaries.name: Burst
primaries.desc: Three hard, accurate rounds a pull, then a beat
use: LMB
Each pull fires a three-round burst; pull again after the beat
Accurate to mid range, fading past 40 m

primaries.name: Rifle
primaries.desc: Accurate, with mild bloom and long reach
use: LMB
Hold to fire 8 rounds a second
Full damage out to 60 m, and still 60% at 120 m

primaries.name: Gatling
primaries.desc: A rotary cannon that spins up to a torrent, and runs hot
use: LMB
Hold: it opens fire after 0.2 s and reaches full rate after 1.2 s
Let go and it spins down over 0.8 s: fire long bursts, and watch your heat

primaries.name: Flak
use: LMB
Each shot is eight pellets in a wide cone
Full damage inside 15 m, a fifth past 45 m: close in first

primaries.name: HEAT
primaries.desc: A charged cannon whose burning slug bursts on impact
use: LMB
Hold to charge, up to 0.9 s, and let go to fire
Fully charged, it hits 1.5× harder, flies faster and bursts 3.5 m wide
The slug drops a little: aim high at long range

primaries.name: Auto-GL
primaries.desc: A drum-fed automatic grenade launcher: a stream of small, bouncing grenades
use: LMB
Hold to fire about two grenades a second
They drop, bounce off what they hit, and burst on a mech or after 1 s
Bank them off walls and floors to reach behind cover

primaries.name: Homing rocket
primaries.desc: Single rockets that curve onto the enemy you keep in your sights
use: LMB
Fire one rocket at a time
Keep your crosshair within 3° of an enemy and rockets in flight turn toward it; a diamond marks it
Look away and they fly straight; a quick dodge can shake them

secondaries.name: Scatter
secondaries.desc: Nine slow flak pellets in a cone
use: RMB
Fire nine flak pellets; each bursts on contact or at 60 m
RMB
Press again to burst them all at once

secondaries.name: Hellfire
secondaries.desc: Lock-on missiles that curve onto their target, even round a corner
use: MMB
Press with an enemy near your crosshair (within 30° and 150 m), and keep it there 0.35 s to lock
Once locked, the lock holds 2.5 s wherever you look
RMB
Fire eight missiles: they fan out, then curve onto the lock
Fired without a lock, they fly straight and scatter

secondaries.name: Repair torch
secondaries.desc: A beam that mends teammates and burns enemies
use: RMB
Hold on a teammate to mend 15 hp/s, out to 28 m
RMB
Hold on an enemy to burn 6 hp/s
It runs warm while held

secondaries.name: Rocket
secondaries.desc: Straight-flying rocket with an 8 m blast
use: RMB
Fire a rocket: 40 damage, 8 m blast
RMB
Press again to burst it in the air
Aim at the ground or a wall beside a target: the blast still catches it

secondaries.name: Rail gun
secondaries.desc: One fast, flat, heavy slug that punches through shields
use: MMB
Toggle the scope
RMB
Press and let go to fire: the slug leaves on the release
It flies through shield domes and barriers, wearing them as it passes

secondaries.name: Furnace
secondaries.desc: A heat-fed launcher: the hotter you run, the bigger the fireball
use: RMB
Throw a fireball; it spends a third of your heat
It fires even overheated: run hot, then throw to cool down
RMB
Press again to burst it early

secondaries.name: Grenade launcher
secondaries.desc: Lobbed shell that bounces once or twice, then bursts wide
use: RMB
Lob a shell: 40 damage, 8 m blast
It bounces once or twice, then bursts at 2.8 s
RMB
Press again to burst it early

secondaries.name: Cluster launcher
secondaries.desc: A canister that splits into six bomblets
use: RMB
Lob a canister
RMB
Press again, or wait 1.4 s, to split it into six bomblets that rain down
Split it over a target or a group

secondaries.name: Mine layer
use: RMB
Lay a sticky mine, one a second, up to ten
A mine bursts when an enemy comes within 3.5 m
MMB
Set off all your mines at once

secondaries.name: Rocket punch
secondaries.desc: An outsized impact head on a ram, driven by boosters: it charges in and throws what it hits
use: RMB
Hold to spool up the boosters: 0.8 s to full
RMB
Let go to punch. The longer the wind-up, the harder it hits (20 to 55) and the farther the boosters carry you (up to 22 m)
With an enemy ahead in range it homes in; otherwise it flies you straight along your aim, up too, as a dash
A hit throws them along your aim, and a wall they slam into hurts. It works overheated, but locks your guns for 0.5 s

offensive.name: Tumbler
offensive.desc: A frag grenade, lobbed: it bounces about, then bursts
use: Q
Lob it: 30 damage, 5 m blast, after 2 s of bouncing about

offensive.name: Limpet
offensive.desc: A remote mine you set off yourself
use: Q
Throw it: it sticks where it lands
Q
Press again to set it off: 45 damage
One down at a time

offensive.name: Pall
use: Q
Throw it: it bursts into a cloud 16 m wide for 10 s
No one sees into or through it: break line of sight to escape, or to close in

offensive.name: MG turret
use: Q
Set it down ahead of you for 20 s
It fires bursts at the nearest enemy it sees within 30 m, until its 25 hull is shot off

offensive.name: Rocket turret
use: Q
Set it down ahead of you for 20 s
It fires a rocket every 2 s at the nearest enemy it sees within 45 m, until its 25 hull is shot off

support.name: Brownout
use: E
Pulse it: enemies within 14 m lose 60 fuel and can't boost for 2 s
Ground flyers, and stop chasers

support.name: Salve
support.desc: A repair orb only your side can heal from
use: E
Drop it at your feet
You and your teammates heal standing by it, until it runs dry

support.name: Shield dome
support.desc: A shield dome over you and your team
use: E
Raise a dome 21 m across around you for 4 s, or until 150 hull is shot off
No shot crosses it either way but a rail slug. Mechs walk through, so fights move inside

support.name: Barrier
support.desc: A wall you raise ahead of you
use: E
Raise it 4 m ahead, across your aim: 8 m wide and tall, for 5 s or until 200 hull is shot off
Nothing but a rail slug gets through it, either way, and mechs can't pass

abilities.name: Speed boost
abilities.desc: Refills the fuel tank, then 4 s of boost that burns no fuel and runs 25% faster

abilities.name: Vent
abilities.desc: Dump all heat at once, even when overheated

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.desc: 5 s of 40% less damage and 25% more speed on foot, but no boost

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.desc: Up to 6 s all but invisible: no tag, no radar contact, and turrets and bots can't see you. Firing or using an item drops it

abilities.name: Power shot
abilities.desc: Your next shot or volley within 6 s deals 50% more damage (a burst, all of it)

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.desc: 5 s of 25% more damage from everything you fire or throw

abilities.name: Artillery
abilities.desc: 6 s of blasts 30% wider and 10% harder, from everything you fire or throw
